                                                                                
 Usage: danvas assignments [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                          
                                                                                
 Create assignments from Markdown sources or export assignment metadata for     
 review.                                                                        
                                                                                
 Inspect, create, update, verify, and audit assignments from stable Markdown    
 sources.                                                                       
                                                                                
 Common workflows:                                                              
                                                                                
   Create:                                                                      
     danvas sources lint SOURCE                                                 
     danvas assignments create SOURCE                                           
     danvas assignments create SOURCE --apply                                   
     danvas assignments verify SOURCE                                           
                                                                                
   Update:                                                                      
     danvas assignments update SOURCE                                           
     danvas assignments update SOURCE --apply                                   
     danvas assignments verify SOURCE                                           
                                                                                
 Identity:                                                                      
   Uses explicit IDs, source front matter, or project provenance; update and    
 verify do not silently title-match.                                            
                                                                                
 Privacy and safety:                                                            
   Some retained outputs in this family are private and default beneath         
 .danvas/private/ in an initialized project.                                    
   Canvas-changing subcommands plan on omission; --apply authorizes the write.  
                                                                                
 Related:                                                                       
   danvas sources lint                                                          
   danvas files upload                                                          
   danvas status                                                                
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ export          Export sanitized assignment evidence as JSON, CSV, or        │
│                 Markdown.                                                    │
│ overrides       Export one assignment's override windows and private         │
│                 membership.                                                  │
│ overrides-sync  Plan override reconciliation; use --apply --confirm apply to │
│                 write Canvas.                                                │
│ create          Plan one assignment from Markdown; use --apply to create it  │
│                 in Canvas.                                                   │
│ verify          Verify declared assignment fields and exact current-course   │
│                 Canvas file targets.                                         │
│ update          Plan one assignment update from Markdown; use --apply to     │
│                 write Canvas.                                                │
│ upsert          Plan whether one assignment source would update an existing  │
│                 assignment or create a new one.                              │
│ audit           Compare a saved assignments export to course policy weights  │
│                 and basic setup expectations.                                │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
